FY 2021-22 Details of improvements in environmental and social impacts

During the year 2022-23, the total investment in R&D and capital expenditure was about C6,934 lakhs. This includes R&D and capex investments in specific technologies to improve the environmental and social impacts of products and processes

During the year 2021-22, the total investment in R&D and capital expenditure was about C5,905 lakhs. This includes R&D and capex investments in specific technologies to improve the environmental and social impacts of products and processes With the improvements taken during the year 2022-23, ~15,500 TCO2e emissions were reduced, ~39,000 M3 of water was conserved and ~1,58,71,000 KWH of energy was conserved.
